purpose: Phase-7A passive tumour-microenvironment (TME) context profiles per species + tumour model. Each names the ordinal component variants (collagen / hyaluronic acid / proteoglycan / fluid / interstitial diffusion / mechanical / oxygen / hypoxia) that describe that context's PASSIVE environment. The frozen package has NO direct TME dataset for this NLC, so every profile is a LABELLED prediction (general tumour-ECM / hypoxia biology) or NOT_REPORTED - never experimental. Species are strictly isolated; no profile silently transfers (distinct values, not copied).

mouse_b16bl6_tme.uncertainty: Passive melanoma TME (dense ECM, hyaluronic-acid rich, moderately hypoxic) is inferred from general tumour biology; no direct TME characterization for this B16BL6 tripterine-NLC context is in the frozen package. All values are schematic ordinal.
mouse_b16bl6_tme.limitations: No ECM fibre density / collagen mass / interstitial pressure / oxygen concentration / diffusion coefficient / penetration rate (all NOT_REPORTED).

human_skin_tme.uncertainty: A PREDICTIVE, exploratory human skin/TME environment (collagen-rich dermis) with its OWN distinct ordinal values - NOT copied from mouse. Not validated for human clinical response; passive environment only.
human_skin_tme.human_translation_warning: This microenvironment is a mechanistic, exploratory prediction of the passive human environment and is not validated for human clinical response.
human_skin_tme.limitations: Predictive only; no human TME measurement; all values schematic ordinal (NOT_REPORTED quantitatively).

rat_skin_tme.uncertainty: Rat data support skin permeation only; no rat tumour microenvironment dataset. No passive TME is generated from skin-permeation evidence alone.
rat_skin_tme.reason: no rat tumour microenvironment evidence -> NOT_REPORTED

context_rules.modifier_not_replacement: The microenvironment MODIFIES transport / uptake / penetration; it never replaces an upstream engine or alters upstream biological logic.
context_rules.species_isolation: Mouse / human / rat profiles are strictly isolated; no passive microenvironment transfers silently - a cross-species use requires a CONTEXT_TRANSFER_PREDICTION label.
context_rules.not_reported_stays: Rat stays NOT_REPORTED; human is a labelled predictive-exploratory mode.
